data.revised_prompt:
Create a compact 2x2 sprite animation concept sheet using the provided manta ray sprite references as the visual identity reference. Preserve the same character: Youyou, a cute fierce magical manta ray avatar with blue-cyan body, deep violet crest and horns, glowing cyan freckles, bright focused eyes, curled tail, compact chibi 2D game avatar silhouette, glossy underwater fantasy lighting, clean HD painterly sprite style with crisp readable edges.

Canvas: square image, solid flat #FF00FF magenta background only. Arrange exactly four equal invisible cells in a 2x2 layout, no visible grid lines, no borders, no text, no labels, no UI. Each cell contains one frame, centered.

Action: compact tide-spin attack body animation, designed for a fixed square game sprite cell.
Frame 1 top-left: wind-up, body curls inward, wings tucked, tail coils under the body.
Frame 2 top-right: close-range manta fin slap, one wing sweeps forward but stays close to the body, no long horizontal lunge.
Frame 3 bottom-left: tight circular water ribbon wraps around the body as follow-through, water ring is small and attached closely to the character.
Frame 4 bottom-right: recovery, wings open back toward idle pose, tail relaxes, only a few tiny droplets remain close to the body.

Strict layout constraints: every frame keeps full subject inside the central 60% to 70% safe area of its cell with clear magenta padding on all four sides. Same character identity, same body scale, same approximate body height, stable center anchor, stable bottom/tail anchor, same bounding box across all four frames. No body part, wing tip, horn, tail, droplet, glow, or water ribbon touches or crosses any cell edge.

Do not add large detached slash arcs, projectiles, hit sparks, impact bursts, dust clouds, weapons, extra creatures, scenery, frame decorations, or any text. Use crisp readable edges and transparent-looking painterly highlights, but background must remain pure #FF00FF.
